notes.title: New Game Release: Red Spider Remastered Is Out!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26957866/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"][/img]To all our series fans,[/p][p]Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.[/p][p]The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider![/p][p]You can find the store page here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582550/Red_Spider/" style="button"]Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered[/url][/p]
